patterns.note: Full-bleed, distinct vertical sections with unique background imagery and character reveals, often centered or with content aligned to one side.
The primary brand logo uses a highly stylized, wavy, custom display typeface, contrasting with bold, condensed sans-serif headings and clean, legible body text.

High-contrast color palette featuring vibrant accents (bright pink, lime green) against a rotating set of dark, muted, or pastel full-bleed background colors (dark blue, olive green, deep red, cream).

As the user scrolls, the page transitions between full-screen sections, each revealing a new character or visual scene with a distinct background color and imagery. A persistent sticky navigation appears on the left side after the hero, alongside the top navigation and a 'PLAY' button.
Dedicated full-screen 'character reveal' sections, each introducing a different 'Zoku' with a unique visual identity and accompanying descriptive text.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a canvas or video element for dynamic, animated 3D visuals. Subsequent sections employ scroll-triggered full-screen transitions, where the background image and primary content (characters, text blocks) are swapped or animated into view as the user scrolls past specific points. Sticky elements, including a top navigation, a left-side section navigation, and a 'PLAY' button, maintain fixed positions on the viewport.
Visuals are high-fidelity 3D renders, often presented as full-bleed hero elements or central figures within sections, creating a premium and immersive experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, expressive custom display font for the main logo, large bold sans-serif headings for section titles, and smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Predominantly sharp corners for content blocks and imagery, with circular elements used for interactive components like the 'PLAY' button and small decorative dots.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and expansive in hero and character reveal sections to emphasize visuals, transitioning to a more balanced density in content grids and FAQ sections.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly stylized, custom-designed 'CHAINZOKU' logo, which acts as a central visual motif, combined with the full-screen, scroll-triggered character reveals that create a dynamic, almost game-like narrative experience. This creates a strong sense of world-building and visual immersion.
